_comment: Fixed semantic families over the official 54 Level-1 values, defined ONLY from the official taxonomy structure (dataset/hv_categories/level_1_to_level_2.json): each family is a set of official Level-2 categories, grouped by the Schwartz higher-order dimension its Level-2 names encode (Self-direction/Stimulation/Hedonism = openness to change; Achievement/Power/Face = self-enhancement; Security/Tradition/Conformity/Humility = conservation; Benevolence/Universalism = self-transcendence).
No dev-set statistics were used to build or tune this grouping.

contrast_l2_ids: Level-2 categories from OTHER families whose values are structurally adjacent on the Schwartz circumplex and therefore easily confused; they are shown in the family prompt as non-assignable contrast values only.
Validation (tests/test_families_and_siblings.py): the l2_ids of the four families partition all 20 official Level-2 ids exactly, so all 54 Level-1 values are scanned by exactly one family.
